meaning.note: A Deq brand mark proposal, not a traditional motif.

construction: A V-shaped chin chevron, the most widely recognised deq, 16 wide and 9 high with its point down at (12, 18).

A single dot (radius 2) above the opening of the V, at (12, 5.5): the daqqayeh, the smallest unit of a tattoo. Its edge (y 7.5) clears the arms' top ends (y 9, x 4 and 20) by more than the 1-unit minimum.
The mark is the original concept mirrored top to bottom about y = 12, so the visual box stays centred on the grid. Two elements so it stays legible at 16 px.
